pr_title: Fix taiko hit overlay animation timing not accounting for timing section start time
pr_body:
Closes #24049.

Also optimises the lookup of timing point to not be per-frame.

issue_context.title: Animated taikocircleoverlays don't animate to the beat
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

Animating both `taikohitcircleoverlay` and `taikobigcircleoverlay` will cause them to animate at the beat on stable. This BPM-dependent animation doesn't seem to line up on lazer, sometimes being offset by a 100ms.

### Screenshots or videos

https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/75596775/b24df633-2298-45da-a5b6-8566ec86353b

https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/75596775/36af8c43-ee46-4358-be3c-cd0a94992789

comments: When testing this on stable (using https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/topics/41319?n=1 as you didn't provide a skin), it seems the animation starts arbitrarily at some point in the beatmap. Do you know anything about this?
Okay apparently it's based on combo. No idea where that logic lives in stable.

review_comments:
The change with `timingPoint.Time` here makes sense, but the optimisation of fetching the control point once means that potentially different hitcircles will animate with a different frequency in case of a bpm change.

Not sure how much of a deal this is, but bringing it up anyways.
Yeah, I didn't mention this but I felt it's better behaviour considering taiko's scroll algorithm also doing this?

I don't particularly mind this myself, but it's not what stable does, as far as I can tell.

If you're fine with changing this then so am I, I mostly just want to avoid a scenario wherein we have to go back to this to fix it again because someone says it's not like stable. I'll leave an approval here to that end, if you're fine with breaking behaviour, then merge at your leisure; if not, we can revert and I'll approve again.

There's a 50% chance people are going to ask for it to be changed, but I'd like to wage against the odds here because I think the new behaviour makes more sense.

Sorry in advance if we do need to revisit this, I guess 🤷
